UPS Ground, tracking number SYN1Z479802543538, shipped on 2026-10-02 and was delivered on 2026-10-04 to the shipping address, left at the front door.

The merchant offered the cardholder a remedy promptly and the cardholder had the option of a replacement or a refund through the return process. We ask the issuer to resolve this dispute in the merchant's favor.
